reading_note: The arc: the ruling loves of self (archons) harbor three interior falsities — falsified truth (water), evil-darkness, and perverted love (fire) — concealed within their forms. The operative divine power (Living Spirit) acts as a wise physician, putting on three corresponding goods (thought, truth, love in operative form) as garments, and by these strips out the three falsities one at a time, in their proper season. The work is likened to the formation of an infant in the womb, wearing successive degrees of natural form, with the soul of divine life (the Youth) interior to all. The teaching then unfolds twelve great works of separation by which evil is cast down, bounded outside the worlds, walled in by fire, prevented from multiplying in living forms, until at the end the apostles (sent truths) signal the dissolution of the world and the Aeons of Light remain inviolate beyond.
